svg.title: Plugin installation and removal
svg.desc: This overview separates installation from managed removal. Direct native uninstall has no assumed cleanup callback; active work and owned settings still require safe handling.

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 2. Host installs the selected plugin scope

color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
html:div.html:span: 4. Sessions use their own managed task lists
